title: 500+ Times Faster Than Deep Learning (A Case Study Exploring Faster Methods for Text Mining StackOverflow)

edges.target: Fu & Menzies 2017 'Easy over Hard' DE-tuned SVM (RQ1 reproduction)

edges.target: DE SVM global model (Fu et al. 2017) as comparison baseline
edges.ref: [12] Wei Fu and Tim Menzies. 2017. Easy over Hard: A Case Study on Deep Learning. arXiv preprint arXiv:1703.00133 (2017).

edges.target: Fu et al.'s DE implementation (tuner code)

edges.target: word2vec models trained by Fu et al. on Stack Overflow java posts
edges.ref: [12] Wei Fu and Tim Menzies. 2017. Easy over Hard: A Case Study on Deep Learning. arXiv preprint arXiv:1703.00133 (2017).
edges.evidence: This paper uses the word2vec models trained by Fu et al. [12] that converted the Stack Overflow text data into the corresponding vectors.

edges.target: Fu et al. measurement: tuned SVM 84x faster than CNN
edges.ref: [12] Wei Fu and Tim Menzies. 2017. Easy over Hard: A Case Study on Deep Learning. arXiv preprint arXiv:1703.00133 (2017).
edges.evidence: support vector machine (SVM) tuned via differential evolution (DE) could perform as well as CNN, while training 84 times faster

edges.target: Knowledge-unit relatedness task definition and 4-class link types (duplicate/direct/indirect/isolated) with precision/recall/F1 protocol (Xu et al., Fu et al.)

not_reuse_examples: [26] LeCun et al. 2015 'Deep learning' - only quoted for a textbook definition of deep learning; nothing adopted or run.
[21] Hubel & Wiesel 1959 - decorative citation attached to the word 'CNN'; no use.
[34] Moore's law, [1][46][41] deep learning application surveys, [3] Barua Stack Overflow topics - background framing only, nothing reused.
[9] Duan et al. 2003 SVM tuning measures - cited in passing next to [12] in RQ1; no evidence their measures were used.
notes: MSR'18 empirical case study (arXiv preprint, reproduction package blinded); heavily self-dependent on Fu & Menzies 2017 (data, word2vec models, DE code, baseline); Scott-Knott attributed to 'Wu et al.' with no reference entry; CNN compared only to Xu et al.'s reported numbers.
